name: RAPID Kniedēšanas adapteris akumulatora urbmašīnai MultiRiveter RP
desc: The Rapid RP160 makes it easy to anchor rivet nuts to sheet metal and other materials so you can then drive the screw into the threaded nut. The tool works like an adapter and is attached to the drill or screwdriver in the same way as a regular drill or bit. The machine must have adjustable torque. The Rapid RP160 is particularly effective for large projects that require many rivet nuts. The tool has a strong, aluminum monocoque outer casing and an easy-grip surface for safe and high-precision work. All mechanical parts are made of hardened steel. In addition, an installation key is included for easy maintenance. The tool is designed for M4, M5, M6 and M8 size rivet nuts. Tower and nozzles are included. For best results, you should use a drill or screwdriver with at least 18V battery capacity.
nt: Maksas piegāde uz adresi vai pakomātu
